Name: Ahimaaz, Officer of Solomon
Summary: Ahimaaz was one of Solomon's twelve officers, over Naphtali, and had Solomon's daughter Basmath as wife; he is distinct from Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Basmath, Daughter of Solomon
LifeLesson: A name shared with a famous man does not make two men one.
